name: Parasite Target Atlas
imageAlt: Screenshot of Parasite Target Atlas website
description: Atlas that maps human disease targets to parasite-derived molecules, grades the evidence, and turns scattered research into experiment-ready briefs.
longDescription: My own research project on parasite-derived molecules for drug discovery and autoimmune medicine. The atlas maps ranked human disease targets to parasite, tick, helminth and viral molecules that act on them, grades the strength of the evidence, and adds pathway context. The result is a set of clear hypotheses and experiment-ready briefs instead of scattered literature. It is the best thing I have built.
